global.title: Stoke Space raises $1 billion and unveils larger launch vehicle
global.summary: PARIS — Stoke Space Technologies, a company nearing the first flight of a fully reusable launch vehicle, has raised $1 billion to help accelerate work on a larger rocket.

global.summary: WASHINGTON — Earth observation company Satellogic named former National Geospatial-Intelligence Agency director Frank “Trey” Whitworth as president, the company announced Sept. 8.

global.title: ESA opens call for plant to produce radioisotope spacecraft heaters in Europe
global.summary: JOHANNESBURG — The European Space Agency is moving ahead with plans to establish a pilot plant intended to produce sovereign European-manufactured americium-241 radioisotope heater units (RHUs), devices that use heat generated by radioactive decay to keep spacecraft components warm enough to operate, for future exploration missions.

global.title: War Game: China gets its own Golden Dome, sparking a space arms race
global.summary: An unspoken assumption in the Golden Dome’s development is that America will be the only nation to deploy such a system. The Nonproliferation Policy Education Center (NPEC)’s three-day multiple-move space game, which took place this June, assumed otherwise.
